# Synthetic Android collector CSV

`synthetic-collector.txt` is emitted by `CaptureLogTest.generateSyntheticIntakeFixture`
in `pnt/android-collector`. It contains invented clocks and measurements, including
integers above 2^53, repeated GPS rows, a missing GNSS epoch, another constellation
and an empty callback. No phone observation, position or NTS packet is present.

The collector CI compares generated bytes with this fixture on Linux and Windows,
then exercises the existing Python intake, UTC adapter and replay. This is format
and fail-closed qualification, not GNSS performance or physical timing evidence.
